meta.title: Peak reminder
meta.description: Shows a status dot in the conversation header for DeepSeek's price schedule: red with a pulse during peak hours, amber in the 30 minutes before peak starts, and green during off-peak. Click the dot for a countdown, a 24-hour ribbon, and the peak schedule in your own time zone; a one-time toast announces the moment peak begins. Peak is Monday to Friday, 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC, excluding Chinese public holidays; every other hour is half price. The Host half re-reads DeepSeek's official pricing page at startup and every twelve hours and follows any change to the windows, so a linked install stays current. It reads no session data.
